slices.title: Materialize new Theseus run contract
Define asset-to-interpreter-to-frame-to-view boundary
slices.summary: Defined the asset/interpreter/frame/view binding boundary and preservation levels in project doctrine and runtime thread.

slices.title: Define KaTeX/equation frame interpreter contract
slices.summary: Added a semantic KaTeX equation-frame interpreter contract with object, transformation, selector, flashcard, drill-down, and diagnostic frame refs.

slices.title: Add preservation-level diagnostics shape
slices.summary: Added lossy preservation and interpreter loss-kind diagnostics, with docs aligned to keep qualitative review separate.

slices.title: Build linear-solve asset-to-equation-frame interpreter
slices.summary: Added a linear-solve asset-backed KaTeX equation-frame interpreter that samples active transformations, source/target objects, and persistent selector correspondence.

slices.title: Source active transformation IDs from asset behavior
slices.summary: Added activeTransformationIds to equation frames and a linear-solve equation-frame behavior that samples those ids from the asset-backed interpreter.

slices.title: Resolve equation object and selector correspondence through semantic asset selectors
slices.summary: Added selectorCorrespondenceRefs to equation frames and populated them from semantic transformation correspondence.

slices.title: Attach inspection API output to equation frame samples
slices.summary: Attached compact inspection metadata to behavior-sampled equation frames, including behavior id, time, progress, phase id, active transformations, and active selectors.

slices.title: Wire drill-down hooks into equation frame/sample metadata
slices.summary: Added drillDownIds to active linear-solve equation frames by matching asset drill-down hooks to the active semantic transformation.

slices.title: Wire flashcard references into equation frame/sample metadata
slices.summary: Added flashcardIds to active linear-solve equation frames by matching frame transformations to flashcard transformation refs.

slices.title: Make linear-solve tutorial card consume interpreter path
slices.summary: Wired the live linear-solve tutorial equation frame to consume the asset-backed semantic equation-frame behavior alongside the existing visual motion frame.

slices.title: Keep existing card/export behavior stable after source-of-truth swap
slices.summary: Added export regression coverage proving semantic-enriched equation frames preserve existing export ordering, visual transition fields, and rewind identity.

slices.title: Add selector correspondence law helper
slices.summary: Added an equation-frame selector correspondence closure law helper that fails when correspondence refs point outside frame selector refs.

slices.title: Add diagram associativity law helper
slices.summary: Added diagram sequence associativity law helper comparing source/target boundaries and forward phase order under regrouping.

slices.title: Add interpreter composition and loss diagnostics tests
slices.summary: Added interpreter loss-reporting law checks for explicit composition loss, silent non-strict interpretations, unnamed warning/error losses, and strict outputs that still report loss diagnostics.

slices.title: Add flashcard reference-closure law
slices.summary: Added a flashcard reference-closure law helper and tests over asset, selector, and transformation references.

slices.title: Add dashboard preview interpreter for semantic asset rows
slices.summary: Added a dashboard asset-preview interpreter producing preview fields, search fields, and validation diagnostics from semantic asset bundles.

slices.title: Show linear-solve asset preview data from interpreter path
slices.summary: Wired the selected linear-solve asset dashboard row to display preview fields from the semantic dashboard asset-preview interpreter.

slices.title: Add preview rows for drill-downs and flashcards
slices.summary: Generated dashboard object-gallery rows for the linear-solve drill-down hook and flashcards from semantic asset definitions.

slices.title: Add generated algebra tutorial fixture v0
slices.summary: Added a generated linear-solve tutorial fixture path that emits semantic assets, transformations, diagram, trace steps, and flashcards with law coverage.

slices.title: Add second simple solve example through generated fixture path
slices.summary: Added a generated linear-solve fixture registry with a second y + 5 = 12 solve example through the generator path.

slices.title: Add dashboard rows for generated tutorial family readiness
slices.summary: Added dashboard object-gallery rows for generated algebra tutorial fixtures with interpreter-backed preview fields.
